def cheapest = attributes?.uriParams?.cheapest ?: payload?.cheapest def withBalcony = attributes?.uriParams?.withBalcony ?: payload?.withBalcony
def xml = '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>' + '<soapenv:Envelope xmlns:soapenv="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/" xmlns="">' + '<soapenv:Body>' + '<find_with_balcony_request>' + '<cheapest>' + cheapest + '</cheapest>' + '<with_balcony>' + withBalcony + '</with_balcony>' + '</find_with_balcony_request>' + '</soapenv:Body>' + '</soapenv:Envelope>'
message.setPayload(xml)
